tool_calls.name:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os, tempfile

path = Path('main.go')
content = '''// This small program demonstrates rendering a template with a cryptographically secure random value.
package main

import (
\\t\"crypto/rand\"
\\t\"fmt\"
\\t\"math/big\"
\\t\"os\"
\\t\"text/template\"
)

func main() {
\\tn, err := rand.Int(rand.Reader, big.NewInt(1_000_000))
\\tif err "'!= nil {
'"\\t\\tfmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, \"generate random integer:\", err)
\\t\\tos.Exit(1)
\\t}

\\ttmpl := template.Must(template.New(\"greeting\").Parse(\"Hello World {{.}}\\\\n\"))
\\tif err := tmpl.Execute(os.Stdout, n); err "'!= nil {
'"\\t\\tfmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, \"render greeting:\", err)
\\t\\tos.Exit(1)
\\t}
}
'''
fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=path.parent, prefix='.main.go.')
try:
    with os.fdopen(fd, 'w') as f:
        f.write(content)
        f.flush()
        os.fsync(f.fileno())
    os.replace(tmp, path)
finally:
    if os.path.exists(tmp):
        os.unlink(tmp)
PY
gofmt -w main.go
cat main.go
git diff -- main.go go.mod go.sum"
